run_video_classification_training: run the VideoClassificationTrainApp to train a video classification model using PyTorch Lightning
test_video_classification_model: test a trained video classification model using the VideoClassificationTrainApp test method
launch_submitit_job: launch a distributed training job on a SLURM cluster using the submitit_launcher function
create_train_app_config: create a VideoClassificationTrainAppConf dataclass with module, trainer, datamodule, logger, and callback defaults
instantiate_lightning_module: instantiate a PyTorch Lightning module from Hydra config using get_lightning_module in VideoClassificationTrainApp
